source_facts.fact: Decayed outer-product hidden-state memory; matrix-vector application is dot-product attention over prior hidden states (Eq1-4).
Repeated query update has sustained slow/input boundary, nonlinearity and layer normalization (Eq2/5).
Default fast learning rate .5 and decay .95 unless stated; validation grid search; LN used for remaining experiments.

Associative retrieval uses eta .5/lambda .9, ReLU and one fast update per time step; RL averages top5 random-search models. Sustained boundary and identity-memory variants are not exactly equivalent for nonzero memory.

own_algebra.definitions: Bt=rho_t+EPS I; B=sumBt; A=sumuBt; z0=(phi* A phi)/(phi* B phi); C=A-z0B fixed
own_algebra.normalized_exponential_identity: exp(sC)phi/||exp(sC)phi|| = exp(s sum_t(u_t-z0)rho_t)phi/||exp(s sum_t(u_t-z0)rho_t)phi|| for finite real s
own_algebra.boundary: Scalar-identity factor cancels only in normalized query. EPS still determines z0 and final original readout. No EPS or operator change.
own_algebra.interpretation: class-dependent signed outer-product operator and spectral filter; known building blocks, not accepted new theory
own_algebra.conditional_linear_iteration: For hypothetical f=identity, no LN, h0=b, and h_{k+1}=b+Mh_k: hS=sum_{k=0}^S M^k b. This is NOT the actual nonlinear Ba Eq5 or a proof of model inequivalence.
